run.pipeline: Augur 0.3.0 - Phase 1 Step 3: LLM API candidate labeling

llm.invocation_mode: in-session labeling by the agent's underlying LLM (no external LLM API calls; per-site context dumps in labels/_work/dump_*.txt were reviewed by the model before each family decision)

prompt_contract.system: Classify candidate APIs for a single CWE pass (pass 2, CWE-78 command injection); prefer conservative recall; mark sanitizers only with concrete evidence; do not auto-treat every network message field as a source or every subprocess call as a confirmed vulnerability.
prompt_contract.row_contract: For each CSV row: read the real source at file:line (and enclosing function), decide (a) is the data external input, (b) can an attacker control it, (c) is it validated/coerced/transformed, (d) is it a CWE-78 taint-tracking source or a genuine exec sink with a dangerous argument index, (e) shell=True vs argv-list vs static literal, (f) effective sanitizers or internal wrappers.
prompt_contract.labels: role in {source,sink,sanitizer,summary,none}; classification in {tp,fp,candidate,unknown}; evidence cites verbatim source lines.
